messages:
mira: Heads-up — the migration playbook PR is blocked by a proxy/alias mismatch. Docs switched examples to rwd-conv-v2 but the control-plane proxy still routes rwd-chat to the legacy v1 model. Smoke tests fail; need infra to flip alias and docs to include a short ops checklist + defensive snippets.

alex: Can you paste the failing CI repro? I can try reproducing locally.

mira: CI repro (trimmed): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/responses -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-chat","input":"test"}'` returns 410 with body: `{"error":"model retired, try rwd-conv-v2"}` while docs expect v2 output.

kevin: I can schedule the alias update but need a brief maintenance window and a rollback plan. Alias mappings live in `/etc/redwood/routes/alias-mapping.yaml`. Plan: schedule flip at 03:00 PT, run `systemctl reload redwood-routing`, then purge caches.

julia: I'll update the migration guide to document the exact alias YAML and a tiny troubleshooting section. Proposed YAML snippet for docs: `aliases:\n  rwd-chat: rwd-conv-v2\n  rwd-embed: rwd-embed-v2` and a short note: "If you cannot flip routing immediately, use client alias_map as a short-term fallback."

sam: I'll re-run smoke after the flip. My quick local command: `REDWOOD_ENV=staging make smoke TARGET=model-swap`. Also will run regression: `make smoke-regression`. If control-plane caches stale, add a cache-bust header.

alex: Reproduced locally. Gateway returns header `X-Deprecated-Model: v1` pre-flip; after flip we should see `X-Alias-Version: v2`.

mira: Julia — when you update the guide, include two defensive code snippets: 1) JS client alias_map fallback, 2) Python embed consumer that checks `len(resp['embedding'])` instead of assuming dims.

julia: Added snippets:
JS fallback:
```js
// short-term alias map
const client = new RedwoodClient({aliasMap: {"rwd-chat": "rwd-conv-v2"}})
await client.responses.create({model: 'rwd-chat', input: 'hello'})
```
Python embed check:
```py
# defensive embed handling
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='rwd-embed-v2', input='hi')
vec = resp.get('embedding')
if not vec or len(vec) not in (768,1536):
    raise RuntimeError('unexpected embedding dim: ' + str(len(vec) if vec else 0))
```
Also added ops checklist: edit alias file -> reload routing -> purge caches -> verify header -> run smoke.

kevin: Flip scheduled for 03:00 PT (30m watch). Rollback: revert alias file and `systemctl reload redwood-routing`. I'll include a one-liner cache purge: `curl -X PURGE https://controlplane.redwood.ai/aliases`.

sam: Post-flip I'll run smoke and post CI link. If smoke fails, revert and tag docs for rollback.

docs-bot: PR #799: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/799 — docs-smoke failing until alias flip.

kevin: Flip done ✅ — aliases updated, routing reloaded, purge run. Rolling window 03:00–03:15 PT.

alex: Smoke passed locally. CI smoke job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/docs-smoke/799-5 — all checks green. No infra follow-up needed.

julia: Merged migration guide update with YAML, snippets, ops checklist, and a short FAQ entry "Why did my embedding length change?" recommending runtime checks. Also added legal retention line in the footer.

mira: Thanks — closing this thread. If anyone sees sample breakage after merge, reopen and tag infra/docs. :tada:
